title: Micro legal onboarding coverage matrix (ad-hoc asks)
content:
Purpose: quick cross-functional tracker for one-off legal onboarding asks that require ops/infra/product input. This is intentionally lightweight: surface owners, blockers, estimated effort (hours), and a recommended short cadence for follow-up.

Table (columns): Request | Origin | Priority | Owner | Est Effort (hrs) | Risk (L/M/H) | Blocking deps | Quick notes / next step | ETA | Status

Rows:
1) NDA ingestion template alignment | Legal | High | Leah Gomez (Legal) -> Marcus Patel (Billing) | 8 | M | billing schema change (DB), contract team review | Need product to map billing fields -> Marcus to open DB change PR; Leah to share sample templates by 2026-09-17 | 2026-09-24 | open

2) Data residency checkbox for EU enterprise plan | Sales / Enterprise | High | Sofia Rivera (Private Deploy) | 16 | H | KMS integration, infra infra-networking (VPC) smoke tests | Private deploy team to confirm KMS vendor list; infra to validate VPN-conduit by 09-20 | 2026-10-01 | in_progress

3) Audit log retention SLAs (30d -> 365d) | Compliance | Medium | Marcus Patel (Platform Eng) | 24 | H | storage cost approval, observability retention policy change | Quick cost sketch below; route to finance for permanent budget change; temp retention work-around: bucket lifecycle rule | 2026-10-08 | blocked (budget)
4) Contracted model access limitation (IP tagging) | Product Security | Medium | Avery Chen (Product-ops) / Eng-security | 12 | M | model serving tagging support, routing policies | Need eng-security to spec model-tag header; product to prototype canary route | 2026-09-29 | open
5) Billing CSV export with legal-friendly labels | Finance | Low | Marcus Patel (Billing) | 6 | L | small UI change, CSV header map | Marcus to do a 1-PR change; QA 1 day | 2026-09-22 | in_progress

Quick cost sketch for 3) Audit log retention (ballpark):
- Current 30d avg storage: 18 TB/month -> cost $1.8k/month (example)
- Moving to 365d -> ~12x -> +$19k/month incremental
- Engineering one-time work: estimated 24 hrs -> 3 dev-days ~ $4k (run rate depends on infra vendor)
- Suggested short term: enable lifecycle to cold-tier first 90d (reduce immediate delta) while finance approves full budget

Effort summary (this mini-tracker):
- Total estimated effort across all open asks: 66 hours (~8.25 dev-days)
- Suggested operational cadence: 10–15 minute async triage twice weekly; one 30-minute sync weekly (owner rotation: product-ops runs the sync)

Immediate next actions (owner -> action -> by):
- Leah -> share NDA sample templates in Confluence page -> 2026-09-17
- Marcus -> draft billing DB PR skeleton and cost estimate for audit retention -> 2026-09-18
- Sofia -> confirm KMS vendors and schedule private-deploy smoke window -> 2026-09-20
- Avery -> draft minimal model-tag header spec and ping eng-security -> 2026-09-21

Notes / risks:
- High-risk items require explicit finance OK (audit retention) or KMS approval (data residency).
- Keep legal in the loop early; small UI/billing asks are low friction and quick wins to show progress.
- If any item is blocking > 2 weeks, escalate to the weekly product-ops sync with eng leadership.

Meta: This sheet is intentionally portable: copy into team drive (platform-eng / private-deploy) when that team picks up items. Use the "Status" column for quick filtering and add a Jira key in the Quick notes cell if created.

Revision log (brief):
- 2026-09-15: initial scratch created by Avery Chen (mini coverage + cost sketch)
- 2026-09-20: updated statuses after legal sync (Leah) and infra check (Sofia)
